descriptionChirho: Proper name Yehoyada (יְהוֹיָדָע), primarily the high priest who orchestrated the overthrow of Queen Athaliah and the coronation of young King Joash (2 Kings 11-12; 2 Chr 23-24); also borne by David's officer Benaiah's father and other figures. The bare nominative and prepositional le- forms denote the same individual(s). Target languages are uniform: Spanish Joiada/Yehoyada, Hindi यहोयादा, Arabic يَهُويَادَاعَ, Korean 여호야다, Swahili Yehoyada.
